highlights: Security fix: please update if you export videos (timelapse, Benchmark); a crafted file name could run a command in 0.10.1
QRemesh 2: the new default quad remesher, with far fewer poles and edge loops that follow the forms
Kelvinlet brushes that move the surface like elastic clay, and Capture from view to turn any detail into an alpha or VDM brush
Insert on the model turns the shape with your drag (#34); the local API from 0.10.1 is removed
